findings.B1-19: Eighteen process/impurity cases report paired annual purge-plus-auxiliary-generator CO2 and annual transported mass. These support a within-case partial-process intensity, with separate pressure/composition and reduction-wording conflicts; native HYSYS/PSO/APEA and route calendars are not independently reproduced.
findings.B2-08: A 5000 t ship is selected in the cited 0.4 Mt/year, 715 km design. Source buffers are 5120 t for 99% completion and 5890 t for 100% completion: 1.024 and 1.178 times ship capacity. Average-cycle denominators, foresight and seasonal assumptions must remain separate.
findings.B2-12: The six published best-solution cases quote 32.8–142.1 kgCO2e/t stored. Five scenario values remain eligible only within their postcapture source boundary. Combined 1.5 MPa prose39.2 is on HOLD because Fig 20 component totals exceed its stated best-solution total; no replacement is inferred.
findings.B3-06: At body-specified cluster scales of 3 and 9 Mt/year, reported unit costs are 475.81 and 298.02 CNY/t. Mean sharing advantages reproduce as 19.94% and 15.92%, respectively. Abstract-rate, monetary-unit, NPV and scenario-total questions prevent financial or climate calibration.
findings.B3-08: The financial partial-reliquefaction optimum depends on fuel, carbon penalties, recovered-CO2 sales, impurities and work curves. Abstract 95.7–98.2%, tax-body 97.2–98.1% and other case ranges remain separate. The borrowed LNG BOG rate and process assumptions do not establish actual carrier losses or an environmental optimum.
findings.B3-41: The source assesses441 North Sea sites using pressure-aware modelling. Table 5's 22620 Mt/year total differs from the 14664 Mt/year country-row sum, so the aggregate annual value remains on HOLD; neither is substituted as local annual service.
findings.B4-05: The superstructure represents changing availability, supply quality and a mixing/storage hub. Its numerical case uses biochar/bio-oil data/units, so it is only qualified general synthesis precedent. The reported3% profit improvement is not a CO2 climate credit or validated injection result.
findings.B4-06: Published single-/multi-well totals are 153.21/159.81 Mt over 30 years. Retained source rates sum to5.327 Mt/year and match159.81 Mt over 30 bins. Rounded supplementary heatmaps are replayed, but do not supply exact optimiser output or independent physical maximum kr,t arrays.
findings.B4-08: The regional study reports stationary sources and cumulative oil/gas/aquifer resources within 1000 km of Singapore. Independent implementation of the aquifer equation reproduces 24 displayed resource results under source inputs. This validates that accounting component, not annual pressure service or the complete regional model.
